verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a public API: an API reference ([hyperbrowser-docs-28]), Scrape, Crawl and Extract APIs callable with a single request, agent tasks started with one API call, programmatically controlled cloud sessions with CDP WebSocket endpoints, and official SDKs. Community users report hands-on use of the scrape endpoints and the docs. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
